label: 04-06 FlowFuse Dashboard
info:
Node-RED 5.0.7 + @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard 1.31.0

The built-in Inject path is DEMO only. A separate Link In accepts only the sanitized validation envelope from lesson 05; no broker or ESP32 result is claimed by the public flow.

name: DEMO ONLY — not device data
info:
Requires Node-RED 5.0.7 and @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard 1.31.0.

Each Inject creates the Part 3 eight-field telemetry schema:
{v, device, seq, ts, temp, humi, light, status}

VALID reaches the gauges and chart. INVALID and STALE are blocked and shown as data-quality states. The lesson 05 Link path preserves DEMO marking and only labels non-DEMO, accepted input as LIVE. A 45-second watchdog accommodates the Part 3 30-second publish interval and marks loss of fresh LIVE data as OFFLINE. Gauge and chart values are last accepted history, so the state text must always be read with them.
